GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Race started cloaked in fog, misty rain and gloom. Settled Down midfield 5.5 Lengths on fence, railed up to 3.5 Lengths turning, cut coprner hugging fence, took the Lead on straightening and raced clear down the straight, Headed in the final stride # pipped on post
Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 7 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 5 Lengths Four Wide turning, hooked widest Straightening Up and Made Ground down the outside in Straight # ran on fairly

Hampered at the start, Eased & Settled Down last 8 Lengths from the lead, Drifted Back to 9 Lengths Two Wide turning, steered centre of track Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # got a long way back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hampered at the start. Passing the 1000m, eased when close to heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly then Eased and Settled Down last 8 Lengths from the lead, Moved Up to 5.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted 3-4 Wide Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running from passing the 300m until passing the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Restrained & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to turn then Hooked Out to 4.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Made Ground in Straight # ran on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start restrained to find cover.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Up early on Turn then eased 3-4 Wide at the 375m, ran on in Straight hitting Lead at the 100m and getting away to the line. [Stewards: Got its head up when steadied passing 1200m.] # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When being steadied for some distance passing the 1200m got its head up.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1 length on fence, shuffled back middle stages, trailed 5 Lengths on fence turning, off rail at 400m and shifetd 3 Wide Straightening Up , ran on hitting Lead at the 175m, went clear and kept going to post # solid win

Jumped okay then Restrained & Settled Down 7 Lengths on fence, railed up to 4 Lengths turning, shifted off fence 400m, steered Five Wide Straightening Up and Made Good Ground down the Straight # battled on ok

Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths Two Wide , shifted 3 Wide at 800m and worked forward, joined Lead 3 Wide at 600m, led jointky turning, went clear and got away a length or So rounding turn, kept going in Straight and only Headed in the shadows of the post # pipped on post
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide throughout. Brushed approaching the 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down last of seven runners trailing 5.5 Lengths on fence, made no ground to then Made Some Ground along fence in Straight # never left fence
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in from the 200m when placed under pressure.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Little Slow Out Not Bustled Settled Down 5th Inside 4-5 Lengths following 1st x 2 Lengths To The Turn clear run home Inside kept on okay to 100m, Couldn'T Go On - # run ended 100m

Slow out 1 length then worked forward out wide, into Two Wide position outside lead by the 1000m, held together much same to turn Two Wide trailing 0.75 Lengths , loomed up and all but joined Lead at 200m before leader/winner kicked back and took a length Lead to the post # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Laid in when placed under pressure over the concluding stages.
